name: SSO - Cookie Auth App
description: SSO auth app for the cookie variant. Handles identity-provider federation and issues signed ES256 session tokens as verifiable JWTs.

params.name: SESSION_SIGNING_KEY
params.descr: EC P-256 private key in PKCS#8 PEM format. Signs ES256 session tokens. Generate with the keypair button — never generate separately from the public JWK.

params.name: SESSION_PUBLIC_JWK
params.descr: Public half of the EC P-256 keypair as JWK JSON. The CDN filter uses this to verify session tokens. Must be the exact public counterpart of SESSION_SIGNING_KEY.

params.name: SESSION_SECRET
params.descr: Random 32-byte base64url string. Signs OAuth/SAML flow cookies in all variants; also signs HS256 session tokens in gate-only and header variants — so the CDN filter needs the same value in those variants.

params.name: SSO_AUDIENCE
params.descr: Token audience claim (e.g. https://app.example.com). The filter rejects any token whose aud doesn't match. Must be identical across both apps — mismatch causes all requests to redirect to login.

params.name: SSO_ISSUER
params.descr: Token issuer claim. Validated only when set on both apps. If set, must be identical across both apps.

params.name: SESSION_COOKIE
params.descr: Name of the cookie carrying the session token. Default: sso_session. Must be identical across both apps — mismatch means the filter never sees the cookie the auth-app sets.

params.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_ID
params.descr: OAuth 2.0 client ID from Google Cloud Console.

params.name: GOOGLE_CLIENT_SECRET
params.descr: OAuth 2.0 client secret from Google Cloud Console.

params.name: GOOGLE_REDIRECT_URI
params.descr: Must match exactly what is registered in Google Cloud Console. Format: https://<host>/auth/callback/google

params.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_ID
params.descr: OAuth app client ID from GitHub Developer settings.

params.name: GITHUB_CLIENT_SECRET
params.descr: OAuth app client secret from GitHub Developer settings.

params.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_ID
params.descr: Application (client) ID from your Entra ID app registration.

params.name: MICROSOFT_CLIENT_SECRET
params.descr: Client secret from your Entra ID app registration.

params.name: MICROSOFT_REDIRECT_URI
params.descr: Must match exactly what is registered in Entra ID. Format: https://<host>/auth/callback/microsoft

params.name: MICROSOFT_TENANT
params.descr: Tenant ID, domain, or common/organizations/consumers. Warning: a wildcard value lets any Microsoft tenant sign in — set MICROSOFT_ALLOWED_TENANTS to restrict.

params.name: MICROSOFT_ALLOWED_TENANTS
params.descr: Comma-separated tenant IDs that may sign in. Strongly recommended when MICROSOFT_TENANT is a wildcard (common/organizations/consumers).

params.name: FACEBOOK_CLIENT_ID
params.descr: Meta app ID from the Meta developer dashboard.

params.name: FACEBOOK_CLIENT_SECRET
params.descr: Meta app secret from the Meta developer dashboard.

params.name: FACEBOOK_REDIRECT_URI
params.descr: Must match exactly what is registered in Meta developer settings. Format: https://<host>/auth/callback/facebook

params.name: IDP_SSO_URL
params.descr: Identity provider single sign-on URL — the endpoint that receives AuthnRequests.

params.name: IDP_ENTITY_ID
params.descr: IdP entityID. Must exactly match the Issuer element in signed SAML assertions.

params.name: IDP_CERT
params.descr: IdP signing certificate in PEM format (with or without header/footer) or bare base64.

params.name: SP_ENTITY_ID
params.descr: This service provider's entityID. Register this value with your IdP.

params.name: SP_ACS_URL
params.descr: Assertion Consumer Service URL. Register this with your IdP. Format: https://<host>/auth/callback

params.name: SAML_CLAIM_MAP
params.descr: JSON object mapping standard claim names to SAML attribute names, overriding built-in fallbacks.

params.name: IDP_LABEL
params.descr: Text shown on the SAML login button. Default: SSO.

params.name: IDP_ICON_URL
params.descr: Icon image URL shown on the SAML login button.

params.name: SSO_PROVIDERS
params.descr: Comma list of providers to show on the login page (google,github,microsoft,facebook,saml). Omit to show all configured providers.

params.name: SSO_CLAIMS
params.descr: Comma list of identity claims to include beyond sub: email,name,picture,given_name,family_name. The header variant forwards these as x-sso-* headers to the origin.

params.name: SSO_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
params.descr: Comma list of absolute origins allowed as ?redirect= targets after login. Relative paths are always allowed. Leave empty for relative-only (safe default).

params.name: CANONICAL_HOST
params.descr: Hostname enforced via 301 redirect, keeping OAuth/SAML callback URLs stable. Recommended: set to the deployment host.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_TITLE
params.descr: Heading shown on the built-in login page.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_SUBTITLE
params.descr: Subheading shown below the title on the built-in login page.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_LOGO_URL
params.descr: URL of a logo image shown on the login page.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_FAVICON_URL
params.descr: URL of the favicon for the login page.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_ACCENT_COLOR
params.descr: CSS color value used for buttons and links on the login page. Default: #0066cc.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_BACKGROUND_COLOR
params.descr: CSS color value for the login page background. Default: #f0f2f5.

params.name: LOGIN_PAGE_CSS_URL
params.descr: URL of a stylesheet injected into the built-in login page for custom styling.

params.name: GOOGLE_OAUTH_BASE_URL
params.descr: Override Google OAuth2 base URL. For testing only.

params.name: GOOGLE_JWKS_URL
params.descr: Override Google JWKS endpoint. For testing only.

params.name: GITHUB_OAUTH_BASE_URL
params.descr: Override GitHub OAuth base URL. For testing only.

params.name: GITHUB_API_BASE_URL
params.descr: Override GitHub API base URL. For testing only.

params.name: MICROSOFT_OAUTH_BASE_URL
params.descr: Override Microsoft OIDC base URL. For testing only.

params.name: FACEBOOK_OAUTH_BASE_URL
params.descr: Override Facebook OAuth base URL. For testing only.

params.name: FACEBOOK_API_BASE_URL
params.descr: Override Facebook Graph API base URL. For testing only.

params.name: FACEBOOK_API_VERSION
params.descr: Override Facebook Graph API version (e.g. v18.0). For testing only.
